module: Module 2: MAM Allocation Methods & Sizing Engine
title: Proportional by Balance (PBB): Unequal Weighting (10%, 30%, 60%)
precondition: Master opens 10.00 lots GBPUSD; accounts have $10k, $30k, $60k (Total $100k).
expected_result: Account 1 receives 1.00 lot; Account 2 receives 3.00 lots; Account 3 receives 6.00 lots; sum == 10.00 lots.
actual_result: Unequal PBB weighting: child lots = [1.0, 3.0, 6.0], sum = 10.0. Sum strictly conserves 10.00 lots.
